South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Out, Apply Online Starts
South Indian Bank Junior Officer Notification 2026
South Indian Bank has announced the South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 for Junior Officer/Business Promotion Officer posts, inviting applications from eligible candidates. The online registration process began on 6 November 2026, and interested applicants can submit their application forms by 13 November 2026.

In this article, we provide the complete details on the South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment, including the eligibility criteria, apply online link, steps to apply, selection process, salary, and much more.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Out
Candidates planning to apply for this recruitment should review the eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, age limit, work experience, salary, and selection process before submitting their applications.

The recruitment is entirely online, and no application fee is charged. The Junior Officer/Business Promotion Officer role involves target-based sales responsibilities and will initially be offered on a three-year contractual basis.

Selected candidates will receive a CTC of Rs. 7.83 lakh per annum at the time of joining. The application window opened on 6 November 2026 and will remain active until 13 November 2026.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
Candidates must fulfil the prescribed eligibility conditions as on 31 October 2026. The eligibility requirements include age, educational qualification, and relevant work experience.

Educational Qualification
Candidates must be graduates in any stream from a recognised institution/university, as specified by the Bank.

Age Limit
The maximum age limit is 30 years as on 31 October 2026. Candidates must have been born on or after 1 August 1996. SC/ST candidates are eligible for a 5-year relaxation in the upper age limit.

Category	Age Limit
General
Maximum 30 years
SC/ST
5 years relaxation
Work Experience
Candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of experience in banks/NBFCs in retail assets/liability products.

Important: Candidates who previously appeared for the Group Discussion/Personal Interview for a Junior Officer role under earlier South Indian Bank notifications but were not included in the final selection list are not eligible to apply.

Must Check: WBSSC Group C And D Result 2026 Out

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Apply Online 2026
Eligible candidates can apply online through the South Indian Bank website from 6 to 13 November 2026 2026. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted. For the ease of candidates, we have provided the direct link to apply online:

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Apply Online 2026 (ACTIVE)

How to Apply for South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026?
Candidates can follow these simple steps to apply for this opportunity:

Visit the South Indian Bank official website.
Go to the Careers section.
Find the Junior Officer/Business Promotion Officer recruitment link.
Check the eligibility criteria before registering.
Enter the required basic and personal details.
Upload the photograph, signature and resume in the prescribed format.
Check all details carefully before submitting the application.
Submit the application form.
Note down the system-generated User ID/Application Reference ID.
Save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.
Application Fee
There is no application fee for the South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026.

Category	Application Fee

The photograph should have a white background and a resolution of 378 × 437 pixels, with the file size not exceeding 50 KB. The signature should have a resolution of 140 × 110 pixels and also be within 50 KB. The resume must be in PDF format and should not exceed 1 MB.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Selection Process 2026
The selection process comprises shortlisting, Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview, and Psychometric Assessment. The Bank may modify the recruitment process depending on the number of applications received. The selection stages include:

Shortlisting
Group Discussion
Personal Interview
Psychometric Assessment
South Indian Bank Junior Officer Salary 2026
The total CTC at the time of joining is Rs. 7.83 lakh per annum. The compensation structure includes fixed CTC, performance-based variable pay, and health insurance coverage.

Component	Amount
Fixed CTC, including NPS contribution	Rs. 4.49 lakh
Variable Pay based on performance	Up to Rs. 2.88 lakh
Health Insurance Premium	Rs. 0.46 lakh
Total CTC	Rs. 7.83 lakh per annum
Junior Officers posted in the Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Chennai regions will receive a special allowance of ₹7,000 per month. Those posted in the Coimbatore and Madurai regions will be eligible for a monthly special allowance of ₹5,000. These allowances will be applicable after completing three months of active service, subject to a satisfactory performance review.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Posting Location
Candidates selected for the post will be posted under the Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Ahmedabad regions of the Bank.

South Indian Bank Junior Officer Job Profile and Employment Terms
The selected candidates will be appointed as Junior Officer/Business Promotion Officer. The role is specifically described as a target-based sales role. The appointment will initially be on a contract basis for three years. The contract may be renewed depending on performance evaluation and business requirements, at the discretion of the Bank.

High-performing candidates may be considered for regular employment as Assistant Manager (Scale I) after completion of the initial contract period or any extension.
